text:
Framework 5.0 is out. It's faster and cleaner than any version before it.

We've dropped support for Node 16 so we can use what newer runtimes offer, including better performance. The router has been rewritten from scratch and runs 2.3x faster than the old one, so apps should feel quicker for the people using them.

There are 7 breaking changes in this release. We've shipped a codemod that handles most of the migration work. Run it, look over what it changed, and you should be set.

The upgrade is worth it whether you're starting a new product or updating an existing project.
